subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They are promises that must be kept.”?
options: Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.
It simply took one article for students to see work that was usually invisible.
A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.
In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They are promises that must be kept. Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It simply took one article for students to see work that was usually invisible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They are promises that must be kept. Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.」，答案為「Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
